definitions: A female given name from Spanish.

blocks.text: Yolanda is a female given name from Western Europe and North America, derived from the Greek name Iolanthe meaning "Violet". In German and Dutch the name is spoken similarly but traditionally spelled Jolanda and in Italian, Portuguese and Romanian Iolanda. Yolonda is an African-American spelling of the name. The French form is Yolande. Cognates are the Czech and Slovak Jolantha and the Polish Jolanta.
